summary: Iteration 14 — Mobile (Expo/React Native) surface end-to-end test against shared FastAPI backend. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_mobile_endpoints.py (21 tests, 100% PASS in ~9s). Verified NEW endpoints: POST /api/notifications/register is owner-gated (403 unauth, 422 missing push_token, 200 ok with valid token), POST /api/notifications/test is owner-gated and returns {ok:true, sent:N}. Kill-switch push hook verified by PUT /api/settings {manual_kill_switch:true} → 200 + GET confirms persistence, then SAFELY toggled back to false (per safety note). All read endpoints consumed by mobile return 200 with valid shape: /api/portfolio (equity+positions), /api/market/snapshots (rail symbols BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/AVAX present), /api/environment, /api/risk/status, /api/reasoning, /api/trades, /api/research/strategy_lab (all 5 strategies hunter/vcp/trend_rider/bear_breakdown/neutral_crab), /api/settings, /api/market/candles. Mobile UI (390x844 viewport, Expo web preview at https://hunter-squeeze-labs.expo.preview.emergentagent.com): Login flow works — TextInput data-testid='login-email-input'/'login-password-input', tap login-submit-btn redirects from /login → /(tabs). Cockpit renders: Ananta logo + PAPER pill, Portfolio Value $1,198.40 (cockpit-equity testID), today P&L -$1.42 / -0.12% with red trend-down icon, horizontal market rail with BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/AVAX (all 5 market-{base} testIDs), Engine Status card 'SCANNING' (kraken pill), Recent AI Decisions timeline (5 items, NEUTRAL conf 0%), Open Positions empty card 'No open positions'. Tapping market-BTC navigates to /asset/BTC showing candlestick chart (1H · last 60 candles), Engine Read panel (Hunter setup, Regime BEAR, HTF trend, RSI 41.61, Breaker PASS), and Current Reasoning section. Portfolio tab: header '$1,198.40 equity · -0.13% all-time', segmented Active/Closed/Performance — Active shows clean empty state, Performance renders equity curve SVG (red descending), Statistics grid: WIN RATE 0.0%, PROFIT FACTOR 0.00, AVG WIN $0.00, AVG LOSS $1.60, EXPECTANCY -$1.60, TRADES 1. Reports tab: 5 strategy cards rendered (strategy-hunter/vcp/trend_rider/bear_breakdown/neutral_crab) with attrition funnel (Detected 532 / Qualified 1 / Resolved 0 for hunter) and QUAL%/WIN RATE/EXP VALUE columns. Tap strategy-hunter → /strategy/hunter drilldown with full metrics (SIGNAL ATTRITION, OUTCOMES, WIN RATE/AVG RETURN/EXPECTANCY/PROFIT FACTOR/MAX DRAWDOWN). Settings tab: all sections present (Trading/Risk/Strategies/Notifications/Account/Developer), Environment segmented PAPER/LIVE, kill-switch-toggle present, biometric-toggle present, sign-out-btn present, all 6 notif-{event} switches present (trade_opened/trade_closed/stop_loss/trailing_stop/kill_switch/system_offline). Zero pageerrors during full flow; only 2 benign warnings (expo-notifications listening on web, props.pointerEvents deprecated — both web-only no-ops).

issues: Exchange row is hardcoded — `(s.trading_mode ? 'kraken' : '—').toUpperCase()` always renders 'KRAKEN' whenever trading_mode is set, regardless of actual configured exchange. Should source from settings/environment payload (e.g. env.exchange). Cosmetic; not a blocker. Ref: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:190

action_items: (Cosmetic) Fix hardcoded 'kraken' exchange display in Settings → Developer to read from /api/environment.exchange instead of being inferred from trading_mode truthiness (settings.tsx:190).

(Optional perf) Reports tab uses useFetch(api.researchStrategyLab, [], 0) — refresh interval=0 means no auto-refresh. Confirm this is intentional (pull-to-refresh is the only refresh path) or set a sensible interval.
(Optional UX) Manual close modal could not be exercised (no active positions). Empty state renders correctly, so flow gated cleanly — verify modal once a position is open in a future iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Push token registration (push.ts:43-49) silently no-ops on Expo Go / web preview which is correct, but the catch-all swallows the api.registerPushToken error via .catch(() => {}) — for a real device build it would be useful to log this so we can detect registration failures in Sentry / console.

Settings.tsx writes notification preferences ONLY to local AsyncStorage (NOTIF_KEY) and never reaches the server, so disabling 'kill_switch' on mobile does NOT prevent the backend from broadcasting a kill_switch push to that device. For now this is acceptable (server-side broadcast is best-effort and same for all events), but if per-event opt-out is a real product requirement, the server should know.

auth.tsx:48-53 — me() failure clears the token. Good. But there is no proactive refresh interval and any transient 5xx will sign the user out. Consider distinguishing 401 (clear token) from network errors (retry).

Cockpit botStatus() reads risk?.manual_kill_switch directly, but /api/risk/status may not include that field — settings.manual_kill_switch is the authoritative source. Verify the field exists on /risk/status or this branch is dead code (cockpit will show 'SCANNING' even when kill switch is engaged via settings). Confirmed: backend kill-switch toggle worked at the API layer but cockpit status reflection depends on /risk/status payload.

useFetch hook polls at provided interval — Reports passes 0 (no auto-refresh) but Cockpit polls every 15s and Portfolio every 20s. With market snapshots being a heavier call, consider exponential backoff or pausing when app is backgrounded to save mobile battery / data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, cockpit, asset detail, portfolio active/closed/perf, reports, strategy detail, settings — all flows render, all testIDs found, zero pageerrors)

seed_data_creation: Inserted one Expo push token doc ExponentPushToken[TEST_iter14_mobile] into push_tokens collection via /api/notifications/register. Side-effect: /api/notifications/test will now report sent=1 to that fake token (Expo will reject it server-side but our endpoint correctly returns {ok:true,sent:1,status:200}). No portfolio / trade data was modified; kill switch was safely toggled OFF at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Expo web preview URL is https://hunter-squeeze-labs.expo.preview.emergentagent.com (NOT the api domain). Backend API base is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://hunter-squeeze-labs.preview.emergentagent.com plus /api. testIDs render as data-testid in the Expo web preview. Stable testIDs verified: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, cockpit-equity, market-{BTC|ETH|SOL|XRP|AVAX}, bot-status-card, see-all-positions, pf-tab-{active|closed|perf}, confirm-close-btn, cancel-close-btn, strategy-{hunter|vcp|trend_rider|bear_breakdown|neutral_crab}, kill-switch-toggle, biometric-toggle, sign-out-btn, notif-{event_type}, env-{paper|live}, setting-strategy-{id}. Safety: do NOT switch env to LIVE; do NOT call /api/portfolio/reset, /api/history/clear, or /api/admin/fresh-start. If kill switch is engaged, turn it back off (PUT /api/settings {manual_kill_switch:false}). Expo Metro tunnel can flap — retry navigation after ~30s if preview is unreachable. Push DELIVERY is not testable on Expo Go/web — only the register/test endpoints are.
rca of the issue: No bugs. The only finding is the hardcoded 'kraken' exchange string in Settings → Developer row, which is cosmetic. Backend correctly enforces owner-gating on both notification endpoints (401/403 for unauth, 422 for invalid body, 200 for owner). Kill-switch hook fires best-effort and returns 200 regardless of push dispatch outcome, matching spec.
